description: Unique stable lowercase slug identifying the model; one row per model.
Common name or acronym of the model.
Individuals documented as contributing to model development; separate multiple names with ';'. Leave blank if not documented.
Organization(s) documented as supporting model development; separate multiple values with ';'. Leave blank if not documented.
Provinces/territories where the source says the model applies; separate multiple values with ';'.
Broad model class as stated in the source.
Species or species groups covered; separate multiple values with ';'. Use expanded lists instead of Eastern SPF or Western SPF.
example: Balsam fir;black spruce;red spruce;white spruce;jack pine

description: Minimum inputs needed to initialize or run the model; separate multiple values with ';'. Leave blank if not documented.
Key model outputs; separate multiple values with ';'.
Management actions the source says the model can represent (e.g. thinning; fertilization; pruning); separate multiple values with ';'. Leave blank if not stated.
Other features the source says are represented (e.g. mortality; regeneration; climate; disturbance); separate multiple values with ';'. Leave blank if not stated.
Lifecycle status if the source states it.
Optional filename of a supporting local Markdown document; use model_sources.csv to associate multiple documents.
Citation (authors; year; title) of the scanned source.
Publication year of the scanned source.
Uncertainties or ambiguities; do not guess values the source does not state.
Stand context represented: natural_origin or post-harvest managed stands; managed includes planting or natural regeneration after harvest.
